title: Storey Architecture
description: Pure white and pure black in whole bands, with off-white paper for cards and forms and a single form grey. A tight-tracked neo-grotesk at one weight for everything, a light grotesk mono for labels; square corners, no shadows, and a fluid page whose margins are 1.39vw.
notes: light is the faithful mode: white page, black ink, black bands drawn with bg-foreground; dark is a sibling with the roles swapped (near-black page, off-white bands)
card is the off-white paper of the note cards and the brief form; secondary is the form grey of the Submit button
muted is the pale grey of the ghost numbers and the light media placeholders; glow is the stone grey of the media behind white text
radius is 0; page-width is 100% (the layout is fluid, edge to edge)
the gutter is 4.1vw on phones and 1.3889vw (20px at 1440) from 640px
name: storeyarchitecture-theme
